correctness.rationale: The 27 ternary triples comprise nine reversal-fixed palindromes and nine nontrivial reversal pairs; a length-nine orientable cycle must use exactly one triple per pair. Enumerating all 512 pair orientation masks proves precisely ten have balanced de Bruijn overlap degrees, precisely two are strongly connected, and each of those has reduced outdegree-Laplacian determinant four and BEST factor one, giving eight cyclic Euler tours. A separate 19683-word exhaustive search reproduces the complete eight rotation-canonical word catalog and two permutation/reversal orbits of sizes six and two. Exact source programs are provided.

broader_coverage.reasoning: Unoriented de Bruijn sequences require observing all palindromic three-windows too, unlike orientable cycles, which exclude them. The 2026 constructions and optimal lengths do not imply a full count of all equality designs.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Reversal-avoidance existence, cyclic maximum period, and exhibition of individual words do not determine the count or orbit partition. The new finite equality classification is stronger than each cited fact without claiming a new maximum. No inspected equivalent or dominating classification was found.

equivalent_formulations.reasoning: A maximal ternary order-three orientable cycle is equivalently a cyclic Euler tour choosing one edge from every nonpalindromic triple reversal pair. The sources supply the definition and one or more examples, not a complete eight-word/two-orbit census.

exact_database_or_table.reasoning: The inspected maximum-period table states the numerical maximum 9 and exhibits 001120122; another paper exhibits 001201122. Neither prints the exhaustive set of eight or the two global symmetry types. A failed external search alone is not asserted as proof of historical novelty.

originality.rationale: Known results prove maximum period nine and exhibit particular cycles but do not list all eight maximal labeled rotation classes or their two permutation/reversal types in the inspected full texts. The 2016 unoriented de Bruijn model additionally covers palindromic windows and is not a stronger version of this classification. A year-only 1993 foundation and potentially unindexed enumeration leave stated historical priority risk.
residual_risks: Dai et al. 1993 and Burns/Mitchell early position-sensing papers were identified through references but no publication day or complete accessible source was verified. An unindexed historical exhaustive finite census could already contain the eight-word classification.
The 2003-11-07 source date refers to a day-verified reversal-avoidance preprint, not the earliest historical conceptual treatment of orientable sequences, which predates it.
All exact computations are independently formulated but not externally audited.

value.rationale: Nine is the absolute maximum of distinct ternary three-window reversal classes, important for shortest bidirectional cyclic positional labels. Determining every optimal cycle and whether all are symmetry equivalent is a natural complete classification and reveals two essentially different optimal designs, rather than a routine refinement of the previously known existence witness.
